topic: Proposed test measurement and campaign schedule
summary_markdown:
A proposal was shared regarding a modified testing approach due to delays in Lidar installation. The plan involves:

*   Conducting test measurements starting mid-December with several brands.
*   Initiating a two-month license period (January and February) that coincides with running a digital campaign. This setup aims to measure the incremental consideration generated when a campaign is active.

The discussion confirmed this would be treated as a flexible 'test and learn' project for both JCD and AllUnite.
decisions: The proposed test measurement schedule (mid-December start, Jan-Feb license/campaign) was approved.
